questions.question_text: Will the U.S. Federal Reserve lower its target federal funds range at least once between July 18 and December 31, 2026?
context: Track the Federal Reserve target range after the cutoff through 2026-12-31.
questions.resolution_rule: Yes iff either bound of the federal-funds target range becomes lower than at cutoff on an effective FOMC date after cutoff; Federal Reserve FOMC statements/rate history.

questions.question_text: Will the S&P 500 index close at or above 7,000 on December 31, 2026?
context: Use the official S&P 500 close on the final regular trading session of 2026.
questions.resolution_rule: Yes iff the S&P Dow Jones Indices official index close on the final regular trading session of 2026 is at least 7,000.

questions.question_text: Will Bitcoin close at or above 150,000 U.S. dollars on December 31, 2026?
context: Use the Coinbase BTC-USD daily candle for 2026-12-31 UTC.
questions.resolution_rule: Yes iff the Coinbase Exchange BTC-USD daily candle close for 2026-12-31 UTC is at least USD 150,000.

questions.question_text: Will spot gold close at or above 4,000 U.S. dollars per troy ounce on December 31, 2026?
context: Use the final LBMA Gold Price PM spot benchmark published in 2026.
questions.resolution_rule: Yes iff the final LBMA Gold Price PM benchmark published on or before 2026-12-31 is at least USD 4,000 per troy ounce.

questions.question_text: Will Brent crude oil close at or above 100 U.S. dollars per barrel on December 31, 2026?
context: Use ICE's official Brent front-month settlement on the final applicable 2026 trading day.
questions.resolution_rule: Yes iff ICE's official Brent front-month settlement on the final applicable 2026 trading day is at least USD 100 per barrel.

questions.question_text: Will NVIDIA market cap exceed 5.0 trillion dollars at the end of 2026?
context: Use final-2026 Nasdaq NVDA close and the latest SEC-filed cover-page common-share count available by 2026-12-31.
questions.resolution_rule: Yes iff final-2026 Nasdaq official NVDA close multiplied by common shares outstanding on the cover page of the latest NVIDIA Form 10-Q or 10-K filed with the SEC on or before 2026-12-31 exceeds USD 5T; retain filing accession and cover-page as-of date.

questions.question_text: Will U.S. CPI be below 3.0 percent in December 2026?
context: Use the BLS December 2026 CPI-U all-items unadjusted 12-month change.
questions.resolution_rule: Yes iff BLS CPI-U all-items, U.S. city average, not seasonally adjusted, December 2026 12-month percent change is below 3.0%.

questions.question_text: Will the Bank of England cut Bank Rate before the end of 2026?
context: Track official Bank Rate effective dates after the cutoff through 2026-12-31.
questions.resolution_rule: Yes iff the official Bank of England Bank Rate is reduced below its cutoff level on an effective date after cutoff through 2026-12-31.

questions.question_text: Will the European Central Bank lower its deposit facility rate at least once between July 18 and December 31, 2026?
context: Track official ECB deposit-facility rate effective dates after the cutoff through 2026-12-31.
questions.resolution_rule: Yes iff the ECB official deposit-facility rate is reduced below its cutoff level on an effective date after cutoff through 2026-12-31.

questions.question_text: Will Ethereum close above 10,000 U.S. dollars on December 31, 2026?
context: Use the Coinbase ETH-USD daily candle for 2026-12-31 UTC.
questions.resolution_rule: Yes iff the Coinbase Exchange ETH-USD daily candle close for 2026-12-31 UTC is strictly above USD 10,000.
